verses.1: And Moses went and spoke these words to all the Israelites.
verses.2: And he said to them, “I, who am a hundred and twenty years old today, cannot go out or come in anymore. And Yahweh said to me, ‘Do not cross this Jordan.’”
verses.3: YHWH, your God, will do this before you. He will destroy these nations from before you. Yehoshua will take them for yourself. This will happen as YHWH has said.
verses.4: And Jehovah did to them what He did to Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, which He destroyed.
verses.5: And the LORD gave them to you, and you did what all the commandments were commanded you to do.
verses.6: Strengthen yourselves and be courageous! Do not fear them, nor despise them. For Jehovah your God will be with you; he will not leave you alone or abandon you.
verses.7: And Moses called for Joshua, and said to him, “In the eyes of all Israel, stand firm and be strong. For you will lead this people to the land that Jehovah has promised to their ancestors. You will give them this land as a gift.”
verses.8: And Jehovah, who walks before you, will be with you. He will not leave you alone; he will never abandon you. You shall not fear or be afraid.
verses.9: And Moses wrote down these laws. He gave them to the priests, the sons of Levi, who were responsible for carrying the Ark of the Covenant of Jehovah. He also gave them to all the elders of Israel.
verses.10: And Moses commanded them, “For seven years in a row, during the year of the Jubilee, on the day of Sukkot.”
verses.11: When all of Israel comes to see the face of Jehovah your God, in the place where you will choose to read this Torah aloud, before all of Israel’s ears.
verses.12: Let the people, both men and women, listen to what you say. Let them learn from it and fear Jehovah your God. Then they will be able to keep all the laws of this Torah.
verses.13: And those among them who do not know this shall hear, and they shall learn to fear Jehovah your God throughout all the days you live on the earth, as you go across the Jordan to possess it.
verses.14: And the LORD said to Moses, “Your days are near. Call upon Joshua, and he will stand before the LORD in the tabernacle. Then Moses and Joshua will go forth.”
verses.15: And the LORD saw a cloud in the temple, and the cloud stood on the entrance to the temple.
verses.16: And the LORD said to Moses, “You shall lie down with your fathers; and this people will rise up and worship the gods of other lands. They came in haste, but they left me behind and broke my covenant that I made with them.”
verses.17: And I was cursed on that day. I left them behind and hid my face from them. It became a source of suffering and pain for me. On that day, I said, “Now that there is no God in my heart, then these evils have found me.”
verses.18: And I hid my face on that day from all the evil that he did, because he turned to other gods.
verses.19: And now, I will write this song for you, so that the children of Israel may learn it by heart. Thus, this song will be a reminder to me forever among the children of Israel.
verses.20: For I will bring you into the land that I have promised to your ancestors: a land of milk and honey. You will eat and drink, and you will live in peace. But others will turn away from God, worship other gods, and break my covenant with them.
verses.21: And it will be like this: They will find him in great hardships and difficulties. The song will cry out before him forever, because I will not forget his schemes. I know his schemes, and he is the one who does these things today, before I bring him to the land where I will dwell.
verses.22: And Moses wrote this song on that day, and he taught it to the children of Israel.
verses.23: And he commanded Joshua son of Nun, saying, “Be strong and have courage! You shall bring the children of Israel into the land that I have promised them. And I will be with you.”
verses.24: And it happened that Moses wrote down the words of the Torah on a scroll, until it was completed.
verses.25: And Moses commanded the Levites, the carriers of the Ark of the Covenant of Jehovah, to say:
verses.26: Take this book of the Torah and place it beside the Ark of the Covenant of Jehovah your God. It shall remain there forever.
verses.27: For I know your names and the hardships you have endured while I was with you today. Even after my death, they will remain with Jehovah.
verses.28: Let the community bring to me all their elders and rulers. I will speak to them in their ears these words. I will bear witness to them with heaven and earth.
verses.29: For after my death, I will know that they have gone astray from the path I commanded them to follow. I will call upon you in a time of trouble, because you have done evil in the eyes of Jehovah through your actions.
verses.30: And Moses spoke these words to all the people of Israel, until they understood them completely.
